facts.value: Students of the Department of Economics can receive support and advice for various issues related to their studies.

The E! Week with its mentoring program is the ideal start for all Bachelor students. In a three-day program, first-semester students learn about Goethe University, the department, our campus life, and the city of Frankfurt.
Our Master's students are warmly welcomed at the Master Welcome Day and receive important information.

The event series 'Bachelor meets Business' aims to create a forum for exchange between science and practice. It invites an exciting selection of companies each winter semester. Master's students are also welcome!

The Dean's List aims to honor outstanding academic achievements and facilitate exchange between students and companies. This special honor from the Dean is awarded each semester to the best Bachelor and Master students.
All Bachelor and Master graduates receive an invitation to the graduation ceremony, where the graduation is traditionally celebrated with gowns.
Please also note the dates of important information events and our Student News.
